function.name: detect_beats_and_filter
function.description: Analyzes an audio file to detect beats and filters them based on confidence levels and timing. Returns a list of times in seconds, each representing the occurrence of a significant beat within the audio file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

capture_percentage.description: Filters beats by excluding those below a specified confidence percentile. Values range from 0 to 100 (inclusive).

confidence_window_size.description: Selects the highest confidence beat within a given time window in seconds (e.g., 0.5), to ensure distinct beats are chosen in that period. This is a float type value.

message.content:
Could you clarify what you mean by “I don’t want any beats”?  
If you’d like to filter out all beats, we can set the confidence threshold to 100 % and use a very large confidence window so that only the single highest‑confidence beat (if any) remains. Let me know if that’s what you’re aiming for, or if there’s another approach you had in mind.

But the function requires capture_percentage between 0 and 100 inclusive. If we set capture_percentage to 0, it will exclude beats below 0% confidence, meaning all beats will be included. That doesn't help. If we set capture_percentage to 100, it will exclude beats below 100% confidence, meaning only beats with 100% confidence will be included. That might reduce beats but not guarantee none. There's no direct way to get zero beats unless we set confidence_window_size to something huge? But that selects highest confidence beat within window; if window covers entire track, it picks one beat. So can't get zero beats.
